sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Ravi Prakash Pandey,Suresh C. Dwivedi Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
The written instructions supplied by Sri Suresh C. Dwivedi, learned Advocate appearing for Ghaziabad Develpment Authority is taken on record.

This is a wholly misconceived petition filed with the following prayers.-
(a) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents to pay compensation to the petitioners as provided under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as well as residential plots in developed area of Nagar Nigam/Development Authority, Ghaziabad as provided to the land owners of Greater Noida, whose land acquired, in lieu of the land/plot of petitioners situated in plot Smt. Harkali Singh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36125984/
1 no. 59 & 60, area 200 sq. yard (167.2 sq. Mtr) situated in village Akbarpur Bahrampur, Pargana- Loni, District Ghaziabad, along with interest till the date of actual payment and other benefits for which the petitioner is entitled.
(b) Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondents to provide residential plot to the petitioners at any other place in a development authority of Nagar Nigam/Development Authority, Ghaziabad, in the interest of justice.

entities.text: Harkali Singh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (c) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent no. 2 to decide the representation dated 05.11.2022 filed by petitioners (Annexure No. 6 to this writ petition).
(d) Issue any other writ order or direction, which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the present case.
(e) To award the cost of the writ petition.
The petitioner herein has purchased a portion of gata no. 178, total area of which is 0.4562 hectares by two registered sale deeds dated 27.05.2019 and 14.03.2022.

In para 15 of the writ petition it is sought to be submitted that the petitioner is still in possession of the land purchased by him, the construction of the Road, Divider, Nali and Service Road has already been completed but the respondents are threatening the petitioner that their land would be taken for construction of green belt and nala.

The averments made in para 15 of the writ petition itself make it clear that the petitioner has approached this Court in anticipation and the relief prayed for that he may not be dis-possessed from the land in question and prayer for compensation in accordance with the provisions of 2000 Act for 200 sq. yards of plot No. 178 purchased by them through above noted sale deeds are, found to be misconceived.
The writ petition is, accordingly, dismissed.
Order Date :- 15.3.2023
